title: Chicken au Poivre
description: A playful take on steak au poivre featuring golden pan-seared chicken thighs simmered in a rich, peppery cream sauce with lemon and herbs.

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.quantity: 1 tablespoon, finely chopped, plus more for garnish

steps.instruction: Place the peppercorns in a resealable bag and gently crush them with a mallet or saucepan until coarsely cracked.
Heat the olive oil in a large heavy skillet over medium heat.
Season the chicken thighs with salt.
Sear the chicken in two batches until lightly golden all over, about 5 minutes per batch, then transfer to a plate.
Discard any excess oil from the skillet.
Add the butter and minced shallot to the skillet and cook until the shallot softens, about 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, heavy cream, thyme sprigs, and crushed peppercorns, stirring to scrape up the browned bits from the pan.
Return the chicken and any accumulated juices to the skillet.
Bring to a simmer and cook, turning and basting occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and reaches 165°F internally, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to serving plates and discard the thyme sprigs.
Add the lemon juice to the sauce and simmer until slightly thickened, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt, stir in the parsley, and spoon the sauce over the chicken.
Garnish with additional parsley and serve with crusty bread or egg noodles if desired.
